exposure: Maternal systemic inflammatory indicators before delivery (NLR, MLR, SII, SIRI, PIV)
Maternal peripheral blood complete blood cell count
Maternal general condition within 72 hours before delivery
cohort: The study included full-term, singleton infants born between January 2017 and December 2022 at the Affiliated Huaian No. 1 People's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, who were admitted to the neonatal department within 48 hours of birth, divided into a group with clinical congenital pneumonia (n=46) and a control group without (n=65).
finding: Maternal systemic inflammatory indicators before delivery, particularly a prediction model combining NLR, MLR, SII, SIRI, and PIV, demonstrated predictive value for the occurrence and severity of congenital pneumonia in neonates.
